name: Vertuo Iced Pistachio Vanilla Oat Latte
flavor_notes: A delightful iced latte combining the nutty taste of pistachio paste, a vanilla-flavored coffee shot, oat milk, and topped with a creamy cold foam and crunchy pistachios.
barista_note: Whip the cold foam first so it forms a stable, airy head before pouring espresso over ice.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
preparations.tested_with: Counter Culture Big Trouble or Joe Coffee The Daily

ingredients.notes: For less caffeine, use Half Caff (~90 mg) or Decaf capsules; same flavor.

steps: ## Phase 1: Cold Foam Preparation
In a small frothing cup, combine the cold foam ingredients and froth with a handheld milk frother for 20–30 seconds until thick and airy. Set aside.
## Phase 2: Flavor Base & Extraction
In your serving glass, combine 5 g Pistachio Paste.

Melt the Cometeer capsule (about 5 minutes submerged in hot water, or overnight in the fridge). Pour it directly over the syrups and spices; stir or whisk with a handheld frother until completely dissolved.
## Phase 3: Ice & Milk Pour
Fill the glass with plenty of ice cubes.
Pour 80 ml Oat Milk over the ice; stir gently to combine and watch the layers swirl.
## Phase 4: Crown & Garnish
Spoon the prepared cold foam from Phase 1 over the top of the iced latte.
Finish with a dusting of Marshmallow.

ingredients.item: Nespresso Vertuo Pistachio Vanilla Flavour Over Ice pod

steps: Spread pistachio paste at the bottom and sides of a large glass.
Add 6 ice cubes and 80ml of oat milk to the glass.
Pour 100ml of oat milk into an Aeroccino and prepare cold foam.
Once the cold foam is ready, pour it into the glass over the ice, leaving some room at the top.
Extract 80ml of Pistachio Vanilla Over Ice coffee directly into the glass.
Garnish with small marshmallows (optional: caramelize with a torch) and sprinkle with crushed pistachios.
